fact: The inspection tool was built in Kobo Toolbox and financed by the IDA and GPE grants: inspectors, given tablets, collected school-level data on visits that began in March 2023 in the 560 schools of the 5 targeted regions, and a GEMS-based electronic rapid survey produced a basic education statistics report for those regions in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024; the report describes no record per learner entered by schools.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report on Grants to the Republic of Guinea-Bissau for the Quality Education for All Project (Report No: ICR00328)
